processes.name: Scheduling web app
processes.description: A web application used by store managers to build weekly rotas and by colleagues to view assigned shifts.

processes.description: The service that reads and writes rotas and writes a weekly payroll export to a file share.

processes.name: Payroll system
processes.description: A payroll system run by another team that collects the weekly export from the file share.

processes.notes: How the payroll system is identified when it collects the export is undocumented. Encryption is undocumented.

assumptions.assumption: The scheduling web app is in a network zone distinct from the internal network because colleagues reach it from their own phones.
assumptions.basis: The source places colleagues' phones outside the described internal network and says they reach the scheduling web app from those phones.

assumptions.assumption: Store managers are in an external-user zone distinct from the internal network.
assumptions.basis: Store managers use the scheduling web app as users, while the source explicitly identifies the internal network for backend components only.

assumptions.assumption: The scheduling web app carries business-critical data because it is used to build weekly rotas.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the app as the tool used to build the weekly rota.

assumptions.assumption: The scheduling service carries business-critical data because it reads and writes rotas.
assumptions.basis: The source says the scheduling service actually reads and writes the rotas.

assumptions.assumption: The rota database contains personally identifiable information and business-critical data because it holds colleague names, contact details, availability and rotas.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly states that colleague names, contact details and stated availability, as well as rotas, are held in the database.

assumptions.assumption: The rota database is confidential because it contains colleague names, contact details and stated availability.
assumptions.basis: Those stated contents are personal information whose disclosure can harm individuals.

assumptions.assumption: The file share carries financial data because it stores a payroll export.
assumptions.basis: The source says the file share stores a payroll export.

assumptions.assumption: The file share is confidential because it stores a payroll export.
assumptions.basis: A payroll export is commercially and personally sensitive payroll information.

assumptions.assumption: The payroll system carries financial data because it collects a payroll export.
assumptions.basis: The source says the payroll system collects the payroll export.

assumptions.assumption: The scheduling web app to scheduling service interaction carries business-critical rota data.
assumptions.basis: The source identifies the web app as the rota user interface and the scheduling service as the component that reads and writes rotas.
